name: CANbridge Pharmaceuticals Inc.
summary: CANbridge Pharmaceuticals Inc., established in 2012 and based in Beijing, is a biopharmaceutical company that researches, develops and commercializes treatments for rare disorders and cancers worldwide. Marketed products include Hunterase for Hunter syndrome, NERLYNX for HER2-positive breast cancer and Caphosol mouth rinse for dry mouth. Its pipeline includes investigational therapies for glioblastoma, rare cholestatic liver disease and complement-mediated conditions, plus enzyme replacement and AAV gene therapy programs.
